review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 9 physical pages against the OCR Markdown (HTML stripped, hyphenated line breaks un-joined, inline math marked); no code fences exist in the source. All Table I cell values (162k/7.2k/26k/130k/13k/98.5k/60.1k/76k/55k/1.4M/1M+ rows) match the PDF text layer exactly, as do the Fig. 6/7 caption numbers. Remaining PDF-only tokens are chart-axis values and labels inside the embedded figures (Figs. 2-3, 5-7) plus the arXiv stamp; MD-only tokens are image-URL hash fragments. Physical p.6 was rendered at 120 dpi and physical p.9 cropped at 300 dpi for the two repairs. The paper's own misspelling 'casual temporal masks' (p.5) is preserved as printed, and the figure-internal labels 'Dextrous Hand' (Fig. 1) and 'Varification' (Fig. 2) are not duplicated in prose and need no repair.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.6, Action Expert paragraph: the print hyphenates the word across the column break as 'decodes low-level action chunks, de-' / 'noted by ... using pro-' / 'prioceptive state p_t' (right column top), i.e. 'proprioceptive'; OCR inserted an extra 'c' when rejoining the hyphenated line break. Verified visually on the 120 dpi page render.
